say:3:1130613001:1.text: No, no, the potions are completely legitimate! You just allowed them to sit out too long and their potency has diminished!
say:3:1130613001:1.source_cn: 不是不是，药剂都是真的！只是放太久了，效果才会减退……

say:4:1130613002:1.text: Don't believe him! We asked that alchemist— the one called Smokey! This guy just sells watered-down flavored drinks!
say:4:1130613002:1.source_cn: 别信他！我们问过那个药师——叫阿熏的那个！他卖给我们的...

say:5:1130613003:1.text: No way! I paid this snake a fortune!
say:5:1130613003:1.source_cn: 不、不可能？！我从他那里进货花了好大一笔钱？！

say:6:1130613004:1.text: Visit the real alchemist yourself and have him tell you the truth if you don't believe me!
say:6:1130613004:1.source_cn: 好啊，那你跟我们一起去找药师，让他当着你的面说清楚！

say:7:1130613005:1.text: You better cough up all the coin you swindled, and don't even think about making a run for it!
say:7:1130613005:1.source_cn: 你今天必须把我们的钱都吐出来！不然别想离开！
